verdict.rationale: Pipedream Connect lets developers issue per-end-user credentials via external_user_id/accountId, with managed OAuth/token handling for agents calling APIs (pipedream-docs-18, pipedream-docs-39, pipedream-docs-34), which supports isolating an agent's access to a specific user's account rather than a shared master key. However, there's no documentation of fine-grained scope restriction (e.g., limiting an agent to specific API actions/permissions within a connected account) or explicit least-privilege controls beyond per-user account partitioning. Missing for 10: explicit scope-limiting/permission controls, evidence of restricting agent access to subsets of an account's capabilities, and independent confirmation of this in practice.
